THE TEACHER’S CHOICE.

### our fighter for THE schools STUDENTS DESERVE!
FOR SSFUSD TRUSTEE AREA E
SOUTH CITY DAD
10+ YEARS TEACHING IN THE CLASSROOM
5+ YEARS AS EDUCATORS’ UNION’S ELECTED VP
South City students are not getting what they need. Classes are getting bigger. English-learners are still waiting for real support. Good teachers and staff are leaving because they cannot afford to stay.
Frank Lara is a bilingual teacher, union leader, socialist organizer and South City dad. He’s running for SSFUSD Board of Trustees for Area E to make sure South City families decide how to fund schools.
The working families are the ones who make our schools run. We send our kids to the schools, we teach in them - and our taxes fund them. The money for our schools is already here. We approved it. So why isn't it reaching our kids? These are our schools, and it is time we decide. Our kids cannot wait for the schools they deserve!
Learn more about Frank
## a program
for SOUTH CITY schools
1. Families decide where the money goes
This is our money, for our schools. We should see where every dollar goes, and we should be the ones who decide.
Frank will ensure we spend the money on our classrooms first, not on consultants and more administrators. And when we build and fix our schools, the work goes to union workers on every job. Good schools and good jobs for our community.
As a union leader and fighter with experience bringing working people together to win what we deserve, Frank will work alongside parents, students, educators, staff and unions to build the future of South City schools.
2. Support the educators our kids count on
Our kids do better when the same teachers, aides, counselors, and campus staff stay year after year. But South City educators keep getting denied longevity raises. The district’s teacher-salary share of spending has fallen significantly over the last four years.
Frank will put educators first in the budget and ensure they are paid wages that allow them to live and thrive in South City. We will stop growing the front office faster than we grow the support that students need - keeping good educators is how we keep our kids' schools strong and strengthen our whole city.
3. Smaller classes, starting where our kids need it most
Class sizes in South City have been going the wrong way. Students learn better when the class sizes are smaller. Holding class size to eighteen or fewer students in grades K–3 produces significant benefits in both reading and math, with the greatest impacts on Black, Latino, and students from low-income backgrounds.
Smaller classes are a choice about priorities, not a luxury. But in South City, the Board’s staffing and money choices haven't put class size first - it has been cutting staff and making classes bigger.
Frank will fight to bring class sizes down, beginning with the grades and the schools that need it most.
4. Real support for students learning English
More than one in three of our students in Area E is still learning English - 1.7 times the rest of the district - and they are still waiting for the resources they need. They deserve real support, not just a couple of aides stretched across a whole school.
Frank is a 10-year bilingual teacher. He knows exactly what English-learning students need. Every school that needs a full program for English learners should have one, and Frank will fight to put resources where they are needed the most.
5. Schools that keep immigrant families safe
Paper resolutions aren’t enough - the fear in our school communities about ICE is real, and it is growing.
Frank will push for a binding safe-schools policy. No ICE in our classrooms without a warrant signed by a judge, every staff member trained on how to respond, and a channel we can trust that gives our families the facts instead of rumors. Frank has already helped win protections like these for thousands of families. We will win them in South City!

## Register to vote peace and freedom party!
Frank Lara is running for SSFUSD Trustee as a Peace and Freedom Party candidate.
In June 2026, Frank ran for State Superintendent of Public Instruction as the Peace and Freedom candidate. In 2014, Frank Lara ran as the Peace and Freedom candidate for Congressional District 12.
If you are ready to leave the establishment political parties – the Democrats and the Republicans – to build a political party for and by the people, register with the Peace and Freedom Party now!
